title: AssetChunk
description: One piece of an asset held separately so it can be searched on its own. The text is kept beside the vector so whoever answers from a chunk can show the excerpt it answered from, without opening the asset.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

asset.description: The id of the asset this piece was cut from, in the system that owns it.

chunkType.description: Which reading of the asset this piece is. They are indexed together but recall differently: title_tags catches a keyword, summary catches a meaning.

chunkText.description: The text that was embedded, verbatim.

chunkOrder.description: Position among the pieces of the same type on the same asset. Zero while a type yields one piece; it exists so splitting a long text later does not change the shape.

embedding.description: The semantic vector of this piece. A reader holding another model recomputes it from chunkText.

metadata.description: Whatever the splitter recorded about the cut — offsets into the source, token counts.
